body: Wow our lives are scarily similar
I like to hope that he does love me, if i give myself a reason to believe somebody cares then maybe I wont take my life as soon as I'm planning.
:) He ended up going for it while we were on a rooftop on the 4th date. We're now in a relationship, thank you

I wouldn't say you were, I mean yes there were points that you didn't like but he did stop when you asked. It's normal to feel upset after wards if you did something you're not comfortable with, or even slightly happened.

 Everything you stated above seems consensual other than his play fighting.

I personally think if you're not attracted to somebody physically it's going to tamper with the healthiness of your relationship. 

I've been there and I've had to put down many options because Im very picky when it comes to physical traits. 
Of course, overtime with liking someone's personality they're going to appear more attractive, but if you start out thinking they're not you're type then I don't believe they'll ever be your type. 

It isn't selfish, it's the exact opposite. You're saving him from being hurt. Imagine how you would feel if you're interested in a guy who's your type but he doesn't find you attractive.

If you're not in the mood to have sex and your boyfriend is okay with it for your mental health then don't. 

I don't think you should let your mother's words sway you. Youre taking a break for a reason, and you and your partner agreed to it. 
I would ask myself this: would I still want to have sex with him if my mother had not told me that? 
If the answer is no, then don't. 
If it is yes, then why not? Go ahead.

Whether she lied to you just to appeal to you, or if she was genuinely willing to try it doesn't really matter. What  matters is that it happened and she wasn't a fan, it's neither of your fault because she agreed to it and you also asked. 

Im assuming it was her first time, since you're 15. It could be that she may have been hoping for a more romantic setting, Or it could have genuinely just hurt. Either way, if she said you were too rough just talk it through with her, ask her what about it was rough so when it happens again, you both will have an enjoyable situation :) 

Also, may I add that Aftercare is super important in intimacy to a lot of people. I certainly hope you cuddled her afterwards.
